chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 500: Li Huowang's Desperate Kiss with Yang Na
chapter_meta_description: In a gut-wrenching hospital scene, Li Huowang tries to "cultivate" in the modern world to keep Yang Na close. A new doctor’s theory threatens to shatter everything he believes.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 500 – Yang Na
og_description: Li Huowang tries to use the cultivation logic of the nightmare world to will Yang Na back.
twitter_title: The most heartbreaking chapter so far…
twitter_description: Li Huowang desperately tries to use his “cultivation” on the modern world.

lore_anchors.definition: A foundational concept in Daoist internal alchemy; the singular, undifferentiated cosmic energy that exists before the separation into yin and yang. Li Huowang is trying to manipulate it without even being able to sense it.

In psychology, the part of the mind that operates below the level of conscious awareness but still influences thoughts and feelings. The doctor uses this as a scientific, mundane explanation for Li Huowang's supernatural perceptions.
